PhysioMix crop_r1w rule (validation only; locked criterion sha256 813c4dd12e7e878dcc29b4f153524d41ad0bcfbef38ad62708aa4bf6ab7086d0).
Arm L3_rel_beat_lr_crop_r1w = round-4 winner L3_rel_beat_lr with a 240-sample cropped output, the x16 R1-step clip and the R1 weight lowered to 0.1, about the effective strength of round 5's always-clipped R1 (norm 10 of ~100), same seeds, steps and learning-rate schedule as round 4; every round-3 gate unchanged.
Incumbent: L3_rel_beat_lr_crop_r1, S_arm [0.5943608278716139, 0.5668743628419213, 0.547985797292168], S_real [0.3644958979719713, 0.36495907592226606, 0.34233040924458213] (mean S_arm 0.5697).
Ship the crop arm only if every seed passes the round-3 gates, its mean S_arm beats the incumbent by more than the pooled seed SD and its mean S_real is at most the incumbent's + 0.05; the shipped seed is its lowest-S_arm seed. Otherwise the incumbent stays. The GXU test is scored only after this decision is saved.
